chunks: "Renewing wudu (ablution) for the salat (prayer) of al-'Isha' erases [sins]—no, by Allah, rather yes, by Allah."

key_terms.الْوُضُوءِ: wudu (ablution), the ritual purification before prayer

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of renewing wudu for the Isha prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith states the merit of renewing wudu (ablution) for the salat (prayer) of al-'Isha', emphasizing that it wipes away sins. Its wording conveys strong affirmation of the spiritual effect and virtue of maintaining ritual purity for worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.81 – (Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as) ) narrated that:
"Renewing wudu for the Isha prayer erases sins, by Allah (swt), indeed it does, by Allah (swt)."
